articles.title: Kraken to replace LayerZero with Chainlink to bridge assets across blockchains
articles.snippet: The decision sees a total of over $3 billion in total value locked migrating after a $292 million LayerZero-powered bridge exploit involving Kelp.

articles.title: Kraken to Migrate Wrapped Bitcoin Tech to Chainlink as LayerZero Exodus Expands
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Kraken is the latest firm to shift away from LayerZero tech following last month's $292 million Kelp DAO exploit.
